title: Solution Architect
description:
Hyderabad, Telangana
  
Job Summary
  
  

What you’ll do Discover and shape the solution Run discovery workshops with client stakeholders, assess the current process, and frame the business problem as an agentic solution.Prioritise and shape use cases jointly with the client, then validate direction with a working prototype in days — followed by the production hardening that enterprise delivery demands. Build and integrate Design and ship single\- and multi\-agent systems in Python using ADKs, connecting into client ecosystems through proven integration patterns, standards\-based APIs and secure authentication.Engineer the agent core: prompt engineering, context engineering, prompt caching, RAG / context\-graph retrieval, memory, tool / function calling, MCP integration and multi\-agent orchestration.Build reusable agent components, skills, tool libraries and templates, with guardrails so agent behaviour stays predictable, safe and repeatable. Prove and govern Run eval\-driven development: build evaluation harnesses and test suites that measure correctness, safety and regression before anything ships.Own AgentOps and DevSecOps — CI/CD for agents, versioning, observability, telemetry, IAM, secrets management, privacy controls and shift\-left security — with Responsible AI governance from day one.Take agents through architecture review, security sign\-off and release governance on the way to production, then hand over with clear documentation and knowledge transfer into managed service.Design human oversight into every agent: approvals, exception handling and escalation paths appropriate to the process being automated. Own the outcome Set a baseline with the client, agree benefit targets, and track cycle time, manual effort, accuracy, exception rate, cost\-to\-serve, adoption and compliance as the scorecard.Run a continuous feedback loop: feed production telemetry, evals and client feedback back into prompts, context and agent design. Operate within HCLTech and the client Collaborate with account, consulting, architecture, data, security and delivery teams — the FDE role sits across both organisations, not apart from them.Keep internal alignment as tight as client alignment: follow HCLTech’s governance charter,and socialise and review the proposition with the wider SME cohort before committing the client to it.Look for the scaling opportunity in every engagement — where a pattern, accelerator or approach could extend across other domains within the Delivery Unit — and bring proactive proposals forward. Lead and mentor Set technical direction for the pod: run code and design reviews, mentor engineers, plan the work, manage delivery risk and raise the engineering bar.Stay ahead of the curve: adopt evolving agent frameworks and patterns quickly, and bring field learnings back to the practice.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Technology mandate Language Python — primary and mandatory; other languages and frameworks follow the engagement. For example in the ING context Java will be necessary. Frameworks Agent Development Kits (ADKs) — e.g. Google ADK, LangGraph, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, AWS Bedrock AgentCore, Microsoft Agent Framework / Semantic Kernel. Framework choice follows the engagement; the discipline is the same. Models Multi\-LLM via the kit (e.g. Claude on Bedrock, Gemini, Azure OpenAI), selected per use case for quality, latency and cost. Interfaces Tools and Model Context Protocol (MCP) for integration; standards\-based APIs and secure auth for client systems.
  
  

Skill Requirements
  
  

What you’ll bring (must\-have) Advanced Python engineering — idiomatic, typed, tested and packaged code — on a solid software engineering foundation (design, version control, architecture). Other languages follow the engagement; Python is the core.Hands\-on agent building with at least one ADK (Google ADK, LangGraph, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, AWS Bedrock AgentCore or Microsoft Agent Framework / Semantic Kernel).Solid command of agent engineering: prompt engineering, context engineering, prompt caching, RAG / context graphs, tool / function calling, MCP and multi\-agent orchestration.Eval\-driven development: designing evaluation harnesses and measuring agent quality, safety and reliability.Standards\-based integration and DevSecOps: APIs, secure authentication and authorisation, IAM, CI/CD, observability, resilience and AgentOps.Ability to conceptualise a business problem as an agent quickly, and operate effectively in ambiguous, client\-embedded settings.Client\-facing consulting skills: discovery facilitation, process assessment, use\-case selection, stakeholder management and executive communication.Comfortable working across account, consulting, architecture, data, security and delivery teams to get a solution to production.Responsible AI as a working discipline — applied throughout agent design, evaluation and production governance.Experience mentoring or leading small engineering teams.
  
  

Other Requirements
  
  

A day in the life A typical day blends client consulting with hands\-on engineering. It often starts alongside business and technology stakeholders — unpicking a process bottleneck, agreeing what a good outcome looks like, and shaping it into an agentic solution. From there the work turns practical: building or refining an agent, wiring it into client systems, reviewing evaluation results and production telemetry with the engineering pod, and working through security controls and Responsible AI checks as delivery issues surface.Throughout, there’s a leadership thread — setting direction for the pod and raising the engineering bar — alongside the constant balancing act of speed against enterprise\-grade quality: showing the client visible progress, measuring business impact, folding in user feedback, and turning what works into reusable HCLTech accelerators.

title: Manager – Global Employer Services Technology Center (GESTC) – Informatica Solution Architect
description:
As the Informatica Architect you will architect, design, lead and govern enterprise data management solutions using Informatica Master Data Management (MDM), Reference Data Management (RDM), Data Quality (IDQ), and Cloud Data Governance and Catalog (CDGC). You will define target\-state data architectures, establish reusable data management patterns, guide implementation teams, and partner with business and technology stakeholders to improve data quality, governance, discoverability, and trust across the enterprise.  

Key job responsibilities:* Define enterprise architecture and implementation roadmaps for Informatica MDM, RDM, IDQ, and CDGC.
* Design employer, employee, services, projects and other domain\-specific master data solutions.
* Develop MDM models, hierarchies, relationships, match\-and\-merge rules, survivorship strategies, and trust frameworks.
* Design reference data structures, mappings, crosswalks, validation rules, and stewardship processes.
* Establish data quality rules, profiling standards, scorecards, exception management, and remediation workflows using IDQ.
* Design data quality reporting solution for batch and event\-driven inbound data.
* Configure and govern metadata harvesting, lineage, glossary, classification, ownership, and catalog capabilities in CDGC.
* Integrate Informatica platforms with operational applications, data lakes and AI solutions.
* Define batch, real\-time, event\-driven, and API\-based integration patterns.
* Establish standards for data governance, security, privacy, access control, and auditability.
* Lead architecture reviews, solution design sessions, technical estimations, and implementation planning.
* Produce architecture diagrams, interface specifications, data models, design standards, and operational runbooks.
* Guide developers, data engineers, analysts, and data stewards.
* Troubleshoot complex performance, integration, matching, metadata, and data quality issues.
* Support testing, deployment, production readiness, and post\-implementation stabilization.
* Drive reusable frameworks, automation, and continuous improvement across Informatica implementations.
  

Required Qualifications* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 10\+ years of experience in master data management, data quality management and data catalogs.
* 6\+ years of designing and architecting data management solutions using Informatica.
* Strong hands\-on knowledge of Informatica MDM, Reference Data Management, Data Quality, Cloud Data Governance and Catalog
* Experience designing multi\-domain MDM solutions and enterprise data governance operating models.
* Strong understanding of match\-and\-merge, survivorship, hierarchy management, data stewardship, and data certification.
* Experience with Informatica Intelligent Data Management Cloud or comparable cloud\-based data platforms.
* Proficiency with SQL, relational databases, data modeling, metadata, APIs, and integration patterns.
* Experience integrating Informatica data management with platforms such as Redshift and Databricks.
* Knowledge of data privacy, security, access management, and regulatory data controls.
* Ability to communicate complex architecture and data concepts to both technical and business audiences.
* Demonstrated experience leading technical teams and communicating with senior business and technology stakeholders.
* Experience with other MDM, DQM and Data Catalogs technologies.
* Experience with Global Mobility, HR, tax, immigration, payroll, finance, or professional services data.
* Experience managing data across multiple jurisdictions, and regions.
* Knowledge of enterprise metadata, lineage, business glossary, reference data, and data catalog strategies.
* Familiarity with privacy, security, retention, and access\-control considerations for sensitive personal data and knowledge of GDPR, CCPA, etc.
* Experience with event\-driven data distribution, APIs, messaging, or publish/subscribe architectures.
